research_state.review_conclusion: Jacob’s own parents remain **unknown**. Surname-variant searches of the volume’s OCR, including Glasie/Glassie and Glasgow/Glasko/Glasse variants, did not establish the proposed Isaac and Jennie/Jeanne family. This is a bounded text search of a published vital-record compilation, not an exhaustive search of original town, church, probate or manumission records. The separate Cornell volume 2 covers Providence, Cranston, Johnston and North Providence; its results must not be presented as Smithfield or Cumberland coverage. The apparent early surname hit in William A. Mowry’s *The Descendants of Nathaniel Mowry of Rhode Island* (1878), printed p. 150, is **Glasco Mowry**, a Smithfield household in the 1774 census table. The surname is supplied by ditto marks under Mowry. A separate Jacob Mowry appears for Glocester. [Printed table](https://archive.org/details/descendantsofnat00mowr/page/n310/mode/1up). The table image was inspected: neither row supplies Jacob Glasko’s parents. No kinship or identity between these households and Jacob Glasko is established.
